name: TINTIN-CAMOCAMO - Berochuu Escalation
original_name: TINTIN-CAMOCAMO ベロチューエスカレーション
source:
[b]"Chinchin Kamokamo."[/b]

Sounds vaguely pervy, doesn't it? But it's actually the name of the duck hot pot restaurant my grandfather runs. Apparently it's an old Edo-era expression for a "passionately lovey-dovey couple."

I lived at the restaurant until high school, and now that it's about to close its doors, I can't help but feel a little sentimental...

[i]"Guess one last summer at the restaurant before it's sold wouldn't be so bad."[/i]

And just like that, I found myself heading home for the first time in what felt like forever.

I hadn't seen my older sisters face-to-face in a long time. What's more, the last time we all lived together, I was still in high school.

Under one roof in a secluded countryside home...

This marks the beginning of sentimental, sexy, heart-racing days with my sisters, who seem more mature than I remembered.

As if that weren't enough, my childhood friend and a bewitching traveler also join in, making my hot summer even hotter... and much steamier.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/tincamo/about.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b]“Chinchin Kamokamo（亲亲鸭鸭）。”[/b]

听起来是不是透着点色色的味道？但这其实是我外公经营的鸭肉火锅店的名字！据说这是江户时代流传下来的老词，用来形容“打得火热、如胶似漆的恩爱情侣”。

高中毕业前我一直住在这家店里，如今听说店面即将停业关门，心底难免涌起一阵淡淡的感伤……

[i]“趁着老店卖掉之前，回去度过最后一个夏天好像也不赖。”[/i]

就这样，我踏上了阔别已久的归乡之路。

我已经好久没有和姐姐们面对面相见了。更何况上一次大家住在一起时，我还只是个高中生。

在僻静乡间老宅的同一屋檐下……

与比记忆中更加成熟妩媚的姐姐们共度的这段既感伤又香艳、令人脸红心跳的夏日生活，就此拉开帷幕。

不仅如此，青梅竹马与妖娆迷人的旅人也相继加入其中，让我这本就炎热的夏天变得更加火辣……也更加湿热撩人。

[译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/tincamo/about.html]官方网站[/url]]
